thread:
marco: quick heads-up — onboarding Halo7B (7B, mixed rotary variant) into the int4 pipeline. smoke run shows a 4-token micro-loop starting at ~2300 tokens. looks quant-specific.

anya: can you paste the minimal repro and flags? :mag:

marco: repro steps:
```bash
MODEL=halo7b-fp16
python serve_local.py --model $MODEL --quant int4 --pack-stride 4 --max-tokens 4096 --seed 99
# prompt: repeat 1..2000 then ask for a summary
```
snippet around 2302:
```
... token_2299 token_2300 token_2301 token_2302
token_2303 token_2304 token_2305 token_2306
>>> token_2307 token_2308 token_2309 token_2307 token_2308 token_2309 token_2307 ...
```
fp16 baseline clean.

tess: 4-token motif -> could be head-pack interleave (pack-stride=4) + vocab index shift interacting with cache wrapping. did you compare vocab sizes/ids?

marco: yes: fp16 vocab_size=50256, converted=50260 (+4 sentinels appended). remapping vocab->original indices moves the repeat further out (~3300) but doesn't remove it entirely.

kai: that pattern screams two issues compounded. 1) runtime using token_id-based cache slotting (mod/wrap) -> periodicity when ids shift. 2) head packing reorders rotary pairs so some heads get wrong sin/cos axes. run per-head angle/norm diffs between fp16 and int4 to pinpoint heads.

marco: ran quick head check script: several heads show significant mean diff (heads 1,5,9,13). converter metadata: "head_pack=pack4_stride" for int4, fp16 was contiguous. quant tool applied packing without adding a compatibility shim.

anya: grep for token-id-based indexing in runtime: search for "%" or "&" applied to token ids. i found runtime/cache_ring.py line 72: slot = token_id % self.ring_size # legacy fastwrap.

marco: whoops. that explains the periodic collapse when vocab indices shift. i'll patch to use absolute sequence index (seq_pos) for ring placement and fall back to seq_pos if seq_pos present.

tess: additionally, add a head-unpack shim to remap pack4_stride->contiguous during quant model load. that should align rotary pairs. add a small bitwise reorder check in onboarding harness.

kai: once you have patches, run: 1) numeric repeat test length 8192, 2) small QA eval (100 examples) to compare EM and perplexity, 3) headwise cos/sin alignment check.

marco: local branch halo/onboard-fixes: patched cache_ring to index by seq_pos, added head_unpacker for pack4_stride. local tests: 8192 repeating numeric prompt — micro-loop gone. QA EM: int4 61.5 -> 61.6 after unpacker (within noise). per-head diffs reduced to ~0.01.

opsbot: Created task ENG-ML-2301 "Halo7B: replace token_id cache wrapping, add head-unpack shim for pack4_stride" and assigned to @kai and @marco. Priority: P2. Link: https://tasks.redwood/in/ENG-ML-2301

anya: nice triage. please add regression tests to the onboarding suite (pack-stride scenarios + appended sentinels) and include a note in the Halo7B onboarding doc about the exporter packing flag.

marco: will open PR with unit tests and a canary job. will also try re-running quant pipeline with --preserve-vocab-indices and --unpack-on-load to see if we can avoid remapping. thanks all. :thumbsup:
